verdict.rationale: Design tokens and variables with modes or themes are a fair axis for a design tool like Canva, but the evidence pack never documents variables, tokens, spacing scales, or theme/mode switching. The only related items are an MCP mention of accessing brand kits and the ability to share Brand Templates. Neither shows token or variable management with modes applied across designs, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs
